project_info.name: Prism Capital
project_info.platform: Expo Web + React Native (React Native Web 0.21) + Supabase

core_principles: Trust through clarity: Tabular data must be perfectly aligned and legible.
Dual-energy motion: Playful for investors, strictly functional for operators.
Editorial elegance: Strategic use of serif typography against highly structured data.
Platform optimization: Mobile-first bottom nav for investors, Desktop-first dense side-nav for Line Managers and CEOs.

families.display: Instrument Serif, PP Editorial New, Georgia, serif

usage_rules.display: Strictly for hero balance numbers (e.g., $1.2M), project names (e.g., 'Alpha Fund III'), and major section titles.
usage_rules.ui: All body text, labels, navigation items, buttons, and minor headings.
usage_rules.mono: All tabular values, transaction references, currency amounts in ledgers, dates, and variance numbers in reconciliations.

motion_matrix.philosophy: Hybrid: Institutional rigor meets investor delight.

rules.Investor Home Hero: CountUp on mount + Fade slide (Playful, reanimated withSpring)

component_patterns.Card: White background, institutional_soft shadow, 16px to 24px radius (lg/xl). Subtle 1px border using neutral.200.
component_patterns.HeroBalance: Instrument Serif, text aligned left or center. Wrap in a Reanimated view for CountUp effect. Paired with a soft semantic success pill for percentage growth.
component_patterns.StatCard: Dense layout. Label in UI font (uppercase, neutral.500), Value in Mono font (primary.700).
component_patterns.ChipRow: Segmented filter. Pill radius (999). Active state uses primary.700 bg with white text. Inactive uses neutral.100 bg with neutral.700 text.
component_patterns.ActionPillGroup: Buy/Sell/Deposit style. Circular icon container (48x48) wrapped in a transparent hit area, text label below in UI font 13px.
component_patterns.SparklineTile: Pastel background (primary.50) with a stroke colored primary.500. Soft, flowing bezier curves.
component_patterns.DistributionNoticeCard: Reference code (PRSM-...) in Mono font. Left border accent in Info blue (#6e82b4) to indicate document type. PDF download icon right-aligned.
component_patterns.LedgerTransactionCard: Strict grid. Date (mono), Ref (mono), Description (ui), DR/CR (mono aligned right). Red/Green semantic text strictly for amounts.
component_patterns.ReconciliationRow: Dense table row. Expected vs Claimed vs Variance. Variance column gets a soft semantic background based on mismatch threshold.
component_patterns.WaterfallBreakdown: Stepped visualizer. Gross -> Net -> Prism Fee -> Pool -> Share. Use the 4 brand blues as a stacked horizontal bar (Unit Register spectrum bar).
component_patterns.BottomNav: Investor mobile. Raised primary '+' action in the center (shadow: raised_cta, bg: primary.700). Primary action: 'Deposit / Scan Invite'.
component_patterns.Sidebar: LM/CEO desktop. Persistent left rail, 240px width, bg: neutral.50. Prism tetrahedron mark at top left. Workspace switcher dropdown. Right-hand context panel.

investor_mobile.sign_in: Clean layout. Logo mark centered. Invite code input prominent. Inter for inputs.
investor_mobile.home_portfolio: Hero total invested (Instrument Serif, CountUp). Quick action pills underneath. Pastel project tiles (2-col grid).
investor_mobile.project_detail: Sticky header with back button. Tabs (Overview, Financials, Activity, etc.) as scrollable ChipRow. Sparkline in overview.
investor_mobile.statements: List view of DistributionNoticeCards. Emphasize date and PDF download.

line_manager_desktop.dashboard: Persistent Sidebar. Wide canvas. Top KPI widgets (StatCards). Active projects table.
line_manager_desktop.project_detail: Dense tabular view. Right-hand context panel for quick stats. Deep tabs (Reconciliation, Audit, Ledger) using dense Mono typography.
line_manager_desktop.earnings: Hero total earnings top left. Timeline component on the right showing recent profit updates.

ceo_desktop.dashboard: High-level portfolio KPIs spanning full width. Macro WaterfallBreakdown component.
ceo_desktop.approvals_queue: Split pane. Left: List of pending items. Right: Detailed diff (ReconciliationRow style) with bold Approve/Reject action buttons.

files_to_update: /app/app/+html.tsx (Inject web fonts: Instrument Serif, Inter, JetBrains Mono. Configure prefers-reduced-motion media query)
implementation_notes.platform_specifics: Use `Platform.OS === 'web'` to handle specific DOM behaviors like aria-labels, cursor pointers, or web-only CSS transitions. Native must rely on StyleSheet and react-native-reanimated.
implementation_notes.styling_rules: No Tailwind. Do not attempt to use Next.js. Everything is built with React Native `StyleSheet.create`. Use the design token constants for EVERY spacing, color, and font value.

phased_delivery.Phase_A: Tokens, Typography, and Logo integration (colors.ts, spacing.ts, typography.ts).
phased_delivery.Phase_B: Shared structural components (Cards, Inputs, Buttons) + Sign-in screen.
phased_delivery.Phase_C: Investor mobile-first surfaces (Home, Project Detail, Bottom Nav).
phased_delivery.Phase_D: Line Manager desktop-first surfaces (Sidebar, Grid Tables, Earnings).
phased_delivery.Phase_E: CEO surfaces + Admin visual polish (Approvals, macro dashboards).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Adhere exclusively to StyleSheet and Expo constants. DO NOT add tailwind classes or attempt to setup tailwind.
CRITICAL: Always use `data-testid` on all interactive elements (buttons, nav items, inputs).
Ensure perfect contrast on the primary blue (#064f92); use white text exclusively over it.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for cards or overlays; always use a solid token color (e.g., neutral.50 or white) to prevent content overlap issues.
Apply Reanimated solely based on the motion matrix (spring for mobile investor flow, timing/fade for desktop institutional flow).
